scope: Select established resident callbacks in the caller; retain admission, exact collection and synchronization, with explicit test-only queued-device entries.

timing_pin.scope: GEM VDI development: FX 1.26 at D600, private 512 KiB VRAM, inactive at cold boot. Detection only is tested by G0.

peripherals.name: happy-none
peripherals.firmware: built-in high-level model; quiet command only

observer.mode: same binary, EXEC816_LATENCY_TRACE and EXEC816_MASK_TRACE environment gates; replay with both unset

keyboard_input.mode: POKEY matrix scan; PushRawKey/ReleaseRawKey immediate=false; modifier matrix transitions
keyboard_input.initialization: KEY ALL up enables scan mode before modifier changes

mouse_input.mapping: unmodified built-in preset; all other input maps disabled in isolated test profile
mouse_input.host_path: ATInputManager::OnMouseMove(0, dx, dy); OnButtonChanged(0, MouseLMB, state)
mouse_input.sensitivity: default preset: 16 integer host units per electrical transition; no mapping acceleration
mouse_input.capture: headless scheduled relative motion; GUI uses normal host mouse capture
mouse_input.observer: EXEC816_MOUSE_TRACE=1 logs MOUSE_HOST and passive MOUSE_PHASE in base scheduler cycles; unset for replay
mouse_input.controller_timing: Unmodified slow (scanline) scheduler: each phase delay clamps 0x1000000/remaining fixed-point distance to 1..256 scanlines. The passive observer timestamps output on the base CPU scheduler.

workload.comparison: Retained trusted-request idle baseline; disk and scroll are current functional load checks.
workload.observer_change: Only io_markers changes: use remaining current gateway labels. Timing attribution algorithms and C call sites are unchanged.

validation.raw_scope: 23-assertion dispatch probe covers direct callbacks and test-only gateway signatures in raw and optimized modes. Integration cases run optimized.
harness_repairs: Context assembler needed the platform include path.
Optimized empty Main was one byte; retain a writable sentinel and require four bytes before installing the native jump overlay.
validation.runner_provenance: Early dispatch/io reports retain their actual runner hashes. Subsequent runner edits only add context-overlay include/size guards and change the dispatch assertion count; the selected passing production paths and fixture sources are current.

limitations: Continuous workload, not equal offered load; complete-call counts, completion/cancellation mix and scheduling phases differ.
Charged CPU includes kernel and scheduling return tails and bus stalls; interrupts and peers are separated conservatively.
Idle DoIO p95 rises from 1.047 to 1.495 ms; the additional charge is in native dispatch/return spans, despite removal of the routing gateway.
Exclusive categories reconcile within a sample; component percentiles must not be added.
No pointer, button, scanout or full HY4 acceptance rerun. HY4 and AS4/TD4 successor gates remain open.
The existing demo package is unchanged.
